one_time_products.title: Remove Ads
one_time_products.description: Removes all banner and interstitial ads for good. Optional rewarded videos (free revive, free coins, free shield) stay available if you choose them.

one_time_products.title: 100 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 100 coins. Spend them on shields, hearts for mid-flight continues, and sky skins for your paper bird.

one_time_products.title: 400 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 400 coins. Spend them on shields, hearts for mid-flight continues, and sky skins for your paper bird.

one_time_products.title: 800 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 800 coins — great value. Spend them on shields, hearts for mid-flight continues, and sky skins.

one_time_products.title: 2000 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 2000 coins — the largest pack and the most coins per dollar. Unlock every sky skin and stock up on shields.

one_time_products.title: 5 Hearts
one_time_products.description: Refills 5 hearts. Each heart continues a crashed flight from the next gate (up to 3 continues per flight). New flights are always free.

one_time_products.title: Free Continues 1 hr
one_time_products.description: For one hour, continuing a crashed flight costs no hearts (still up to 3 continues per flight).

one_time_products.title: Free Continues Forever
one_time_products.description: Continuing a crashed flight never costs a heart again (up to 3 continues per flight). One-time purchase.

one_time_products.title: 10 Shields
one_time_products.description: Adds 10 shields. Arm one before take-off and it absorbs one hit from a gate or the cloud sea.

one_time_products.title: Starter Pack
one_time_products.description: 100 coins + 5 shields + 5 hearts + Ads Off, bundled for new pilots. One-time purchase.

subscriptions.title: Season Pass
subscriptions.description: Monthly pass: ad-free play, +100 coins every day, all sky skins unlocked, and a free shield on every take-off. Cancel anytime in Google Play.

subscriptions.title: Weekly Pass
subscriptions.description: Weekly pass: ad-free play, +50 coins every day, all sky skins unlocked, and a free shield on every take-off. Cancel anytime in Google Play.
